creators.name: Andre Mampft (Andre mampft – Foodblog Saarland)
creators.following: Long-running, well-known Saarland food blog with an active Instagram and podcast; the region's best-known independent food voice, co-author of the QuattroPole/Anne's Kitchen Saarbrücken food guide.
creators.credible: Verifiably established Saarland food creator with a findable, multi-year body of work (restaurant tips, Saarland-specialty pieces). Used here as a discovery lead corroborated by tourism/press sources, not as a lone pin.
creators.note: Lead source for Saarbrücken traditional/scene restaurants (Dibbelabbes, Geheirade, Schwenker canon); places he names were cross-checked against urlaub.saarland / Falstaff before inclusion.

creators.name: Anne Faber (Anne's Kitchen)
creators.following: Popular Luxembourg-based food personality (cookbooks, RTL/television, YouTube) whose cross-border 'Saarbrücken Food Guide' (with Andre Mampft) was produced for the QuattroPole city network.
creators.credible: Verifiably popular Greater-Region food creator with mainstream TV and publishing track record; her Saarbrücken guide is a findable, specific piece naming places.
creators.note: Corroborating source for Saarbrücken must-eats (Kalinski currywurst, scene cafés); names cross-checked against credible tourism/press before inclusion.
